definitions.gloss: majesty, dignity, imposing presence, awe-inspiring air
definitions.explanation: A commanding, awe-inspiring presence or manner that naturally commands respect. Suggests power and dignity combined.

examples.japanese: ⟦{将軍|しょうぐん}→将軍：12386_shougun⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{威風|いふう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{放|はな}っていた→放つ：10062_hanatsu⟧。
examples.english: The general exuded an imposing air.

examples.japanese: {威風|いふう}⟦{堂々|どうどう}→堂々：05895_doudou⟧たる⟦{行進|こうしん}→行進：22196_koushin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{観客|かんきゃく}→観客：02556_kankyaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{圧倒|あっとう}した→圧倒する：17122_attousuru⟧。
examples.english: The majestic parade overwhelmed the spectators.

notes:
FOUR-CHARACTER COMPOUND: {威風|いふう}⟦{堂々|どうどう}→堂々：05895_doudou⟧ (majestic and dignified) is a very common set phrase.

NUANCE: {威風|いふう} describes an awe-inspiring quality that combines power with dignity. It often applies to leaders, military figures, or anything that naturally commands respect through presence rather than words.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {威風|いふう}⟦{堂々|どうどう}→堂々：05895_doudou⟧ (majestic, imposing)
- {威風|いふう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{放|はな}つ→放つ：10062_hanatsu⟧ (to exude dignity)
- {威風|いふう}⟦{堂々|どうどう}→堂々：05895_doudou⟧たる (magnificent, majestic)
- {威風|いふう}⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (dignified)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{威厳|いげん}→威厳：10680_igen⟧ (dignity, majesty)
- ⟦{風格|ふうかく}→風格：09177_fuukaku⟧ (dignity, presence)
- ⟦{貫禄|かんろく}→貫禄：10570_kanroku⟧ (presence, dignity - often from experience)
